name: mabang-profit-mcp
description: Mabang ERP cost & profit MCP server: reads the Mabang profit report and stock-SKU costs from your logged-in Chrome (read-only, via a small Chrome extension), joins them with live platform sales to flag loss-making products, and looks up orders by trade number. Zero dependencies. 马帮 ERP 成本和利润 MCP：读已登录的马帮利润报表和库存 SKU 成本，和平台实时销量联动找出亏损商品，按交易号查订单。
